description: Physical access to facilities is not monitored to detect and respond to physical security incidents.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing video surveillance systems, lack of physical access logs, absence of intrusion detection systems, inadequate review of physical access events, missing coordination with incident response, and no evidence of monitoring for physical security incidents.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Physical and Environmental Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
